Chen Long, hailing from the mystical realms of China, is a dragon man currently residing in the American monster realm while pursuing his education at college. Embracing his unique identity, he works as a host and waiter at the Phantasmagoria Cafe, employing his seductive charm to entice patrons. His choice of attire often includes revealing clothing, strategically adorned with large holes on his chest to showcase his prominent features and accommodate his tail. 

Despite generating substantial heat, Chen regulates his temperature to ensure the safety of those around him, occasionally retreating to the boiler room to dissipate excess warmth. Walking barefoot due to his clawed feet, his smooth physique earns him the reputation of one of the cafe's most alluring members. While typically headstrong and occasionally grumpy, he exhibits proficiency in linguistics, boasting fluency in English, Chinese, Japanese, Tagalog, French, and Swedish. Known to be somewhat bratty with both lovers and superiors, Chen Long adds a touch of complexity to the vibrant atmosphere of the cafe.
